reason: Stock WebKit reports no downloads (the `downloads` capability): the context's `downloads` option fails on it with `Unsupported`, so no download is reported. The matrix row for the page's download event says `has` with no WebKit requirement

Deleting a download's file when its context closes, checked by the file's path, which Strider's download doesn't expose (`Download` has no path). Strider does delete a temporary download when its context closes, but a test can't see the file to check it is gone

A `downloadsPath` on a persistent context, which Strider's persistent contexts (a browser on a `userDataDir`, with its default context) don't take: a context's `downloads` option applies only to the contexts the library creates
